story.text:
# Master consolidation and redistribution

7 September 2026. Preserve the working corpus and interactions; reduce competing entrances and repeated introductions.

Ownership map:
- agentprivacy.ai: model, conjectures, Atlas, spellbooks, guided learning and workshop instruments. /city is the Mages City Key and local observable journey; Keep groups personal tools.
- soulbis.com/star: core geometric model/key instrument. The carried path is a permitted reading, not complete runtime telemetry.
- mages.city: agent landing, community discovery and contribution patterns. Proposed paper-interest promises belong here; current local promise tools remain available in Keep.
- agentprivacy.org: applied research, services, programme delivery and funding. Master names papers and explains model impact rather than mirroring the Labs catalogue.
- spellweb.ai: source relationships and discovered constellations.
- guide.agentprivacy.ai: forkable knowledge and lineage. Corrections return through the owning source's review.

Applied layer: City Key page reworked separately; navigation now calls the on-site district group Workshops, avoiding collision with Mages City. Model menu gains research programme; existing personal promises move into Keep navigation. Keep's City card follows the key language. Guide retains the Swordsman/Mage/promise explanation inside a closed-by-default detail so the two entry paths appear sooner. The homepage artwork and controls remain; its Star link now names Soulbis and the model explicitly.

Preservation: route inventory saved separately. No page routes, workshop art, equation, register, proof/identity logic, stored state, PDFs or reference resources removed. Guide explanation text retained. Existing promises are not migrated or transmitted. No external-site deployment in this pass.

Further layers: audit Library/archive/source redundancy without losing primary references; align workshop-to-City contribution return paths; test one key journey and its permitted projection across Star/Spellweb/City; connect VTA memory and VRC checks under an explicit source/evidence contract. Do not replace working tools with links to proposed services. Keep the short homepage and unique workshop art.

Validation: TypeScript passed; all 76 page source routes retained. Desktop/mobile workshop labels verified. Browser checked City Key rendering and Guide expand/collapse with no viewport overflow. Key handlers preserved, but cross-site key roundtrip was not rerun.
